football_evidence.question: Can Kennesaw State contain Missouri State’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Missouri State, and its own breakdown accounts for about 1.4 of the 3.2 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.

EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Missouri State’s running backs No. 81 nationally and Kennesaw State’s No. 128.

Rickie Collins has completed 103 of 152 passes (67.8%) for 1,042 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in five games for Kennesaw State, and has been sacked on 4 of 156 dropbacks.
